reason: I'll just sort it on my next trip to India, my own CA there already handles my TDS and I've never moved money through a startup I found online. It's not urgent, so I'd rather wait than try something new with my savings.
objection: I don't know this company. If the 15CA/15CB or TDS is wrong, I'm the one answerable to the Indian tax department and to CRA over T1135, not them. A free call with their partner CA isn't the same as my own CA vouching for it.
would_change_my_mind: My own CA in India and my Canadian accountant both confirming the process, plus a few verified reviews from other NRIs who moved ₹5L-₹20L this way.
